source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Appearance is packaged by jar.mn, exposed through the appearancePane ES module getter, registered with paneAppearance, and included in the preferences page. Its browser_appearance.js test is registered in the current TOML manifest. Preserve those entry points when adding a related pane module; source existence alone does not make it loadable. The historical .ini test registration remains historical. These source relationships were inspected, without launching preferences. Complete Bugzilla and historical Phabricator timeline/inline discussion remains pending.
title: A preferences pane needs registration as well as its source file
